title: Forge cart receiving radius 2026-10-20
assumptions: Only arrival geometry changes: horizontal distance from cart centre to chest centre 2.25 -> 4.0 blocks. The independent vertical tolerance remains 3.0 blocks; loading, attachment, hauling, unloading and request ownership remain mandatory.

Live Spawn policy read 2026-10-20: 20 vault per completed order and 100 shared completed orders per UUID per UTC day; SHA256 51473a9539fcd0aeb7cf8e3109ad756c6396b8a361ab6e65faadb99c893aae87. No price, reward, quota, quality multiplier or settlement change.

Low/base/high sensitivity only, not measured: 5/20/50 participants, 0.25/1/2 active hours per day; 40/40/50 orders per hour before and 44/44/55 after. Assume 10 percent faster completion to stress the easier final approach; cap completed orders at 100 daily.

At equal completed-order counts delta is zero. Sensitivity: 200/800/2000 -> 220/880/2000 vault per player-day; maximum stays 2000 vault per UUID-day. No global budget; multiple accounts remain linear. Arrival itself never awards money or consumes quota.

No tokens, XP, transferable items, boosts or new sale/contract redemption. Existing idempotent journal and unload requirement prevent a repeated arrival from adding rewards. Cancellation and reload behavior unchanged.

No progression price changes. At the unchanged daily maximum, a 50000-vault target takes 25 active days if all income is saved; at sensitivity low/base it takes 250/62.5 -> 227.27/56.82 days. This is a hypothetical savings comparison, not a new price or observed player income.

Canonical economy inventory consulted. EconomyShopGUI SELL-to-contract transition and all neighboring job rewards remain unchanged. No claim of measured cadence or network ledger impact; native-client acceptance remains separate from the automated elevated-chest boundary test.

flows.basis: Unchanged 20 vault/order, shared 100-order/day cap; illustrative 10 percent cadence sensitivity
